title: [Bug]: When Upgrading using the guide and FAQs I still get a blank screen
body:
### What version of React Router are you using?

6.0.1

### Steps to Reproduce

Updated all the components under the router config as described in migration guide and also updated withRouter to the wrapper described in the FAQs. 

The only class components is the <App /> but really is bare bones all other components are functional components. 

Using the following packages:

Expected Render to be completed and app to work with new Routes
